meta.title: Australia - Winter 2027
meta.dates: Dec 15, 2027 – Jan 2, 2028 (FLL → Los Angeles → Brisbane · Australia Zoo · Noosa · Hamilton Island · Sydney for NYE · home Jan 2)

route.name: Noosa
route.sub: 5 nights · Ocean Breeze Resort, Hastings St

blocks.title: Arrive FLL Terminal 3 — JetBlue bag drop
blocks.detail:
• 2 hrs ahead of a domestic flight — holiday-week crowds, family of 4, 3 checked bags.
• Bags are tagged to LAX only: this is a separate ticket from the Qantas flight.
• JetBlue bag drop closes 40 min before departure.
• Hats, sun shirts and sunscreen in the carry-ons — landing day is a full day out in Brisbane.
blocks.notes:
• Award fares don't include a checked bag: 3 bags × $49 (peak) = $147 — estimated; $39 per bag if Dec 15 is off-peak.
• Prepay in the app; bags added within 24 hrs of departure cost $10 more each.
blocks.flag: Departs Fort Lauderdale, not Miami — plan the drive up and parking.

blocks.title: TSA, then lunch to go — FLL Terminal 3
blocks.detail:
• Buy lunch after security to eat on the plane — the flight spans lunchtime and JetBlue only sells snack boxes.
• Refill water bottles at the gate.
blocks.notes: • ~$50 for 2 adult + 2 kids' grab-and-go meals — estimated.

blocks.title: At the gate — boarding
blocks.detail:
• Bathroom stop before boarding.
• Boarding starts ~30–40 min before departure.

blocks.title: JetBlue B6201 - FLL → LAX - Nonstop - 5h53m
blocks.detail:
• Departs 12:00 PM Eastern, lands 2:53 PM Pacific (3 hrs behind Florida).
• Economy, 4 passengers.
• Lunch on board. Kids: a nap of 45 min max — the long sleep happens on the Qantas flight.
• All LAX times below are Pacific.
blocks.notes:
• Not booked.
• Seen on seats.aero (Oct 2026 search): 16,300 TrueBlue pts + $5.60 per person → 65,200 pts + $22.40 for four. Class U, 9 seats.
• Same flight via United MileagePlus: 35,000 pts + $5.60 per person.
• Separate ticket from the Qantas leg — chosen so the business-class award only has to be found on one leg.
blocks.flag:
If this flight cancels or runs very late, rebook the same day: American MIA → LAX nonstops at ~1:45 PM and ~3:40 PM Eastern still make Qantas check-in (closes 8:45 PM Pacific).
Qantas isn't responsible for a missed connection on a separate ticket — get travel insurance that covers missed connections.

blocks.title: Land LAX — deplane, Terminal 1
blocks.detail:
• JetBlue uses Terminal 1 at LAX — confirm the week before.
• Domestic arrival: no immigration or customs.
• Bathroom stop on the way to baggage claim.

blocks.title: Baggage claim — Terminal 1
blocks.detail:
• Collect all 3 checked bags.
• Grab a luggage cart at claim.
blocks.notes: • Luggage cart ~$6 — estimated.

blocks.title: Terminal 1 → Tom Bradley International Terminal
blocks.detail:
• Stay landside — exit claim and walk west along the Upper/Departures Level sidewalk past Terminals 2 and 3 to Tom Bradley (~0.6 mi, ~20 min with a cart and kids).
• Alternative: the free LAX inter-terminal shuttle from the Lower/Arrivals Level island outside Terminal 1.
• Qantas check-in is Aisle B inside Tom Bradley.

blocks.title: Qantas check-in and bag drop — Tom Bradley, Aisle B
blocks.detail:
• Counters B23–32 open 3:30 PM; check-in closes 60 min before departure (8:45 PM).
• Business check-in: bags tagged through to Brisbane.
• Business allowance: 2 bags × 32 kg (70 lb) per person.
• Have passports and the Australian ETA confirmations ready.
• Online check-in opens 24 hrs before departure.

blocks.title: TSA security — Tom Bradley
blocks.detail: • Holiday-week evening rush at Tom Bradley — 35 min allowed.

blocks.title: Qantas International Business Lounge — settle in
blocks.detail:
• Access comes with the business-class boarding pass.
• Showers available — book one for the kids at the lounge desk.
• Charge devices; download shows for the flight.

blocks.title: Dinner in the lounge — the main meal before the flight
blocks.detail:
• Full dinner here so everyone can skip the onboard dinner and sleep right after takeoff.
• Light on sugar and caffeine.
blocks.notes: • Included with lounge access. $0.

blocks.title: Wind down — pajamas, teeth, quiet time
blocks.detail:
• Kids change into pajamas and brush teeth in the lounge.
• Dim screens, quiet activities — no new movies started.

blocks.title: Walk to the gate and board
blocks.detail:
• Boarding starts ~60 min before departure; the gate closes 20 min before.
• Last bathroom stop at the gate.

blocks.title: Qantas QF16 - LAX → BNE - Nonstop - ~14h05m
blocks.detail:
• Business, 4 passengers.
• Departs 9:45 PM Pacific = 3:45 PM Thursday in Brisbane.
• Crosses the International Date Line — Thursday Dec 16 disappears in flight.
• Lands 5:50 AM Friday Dec 17, Brisbane time (AEST, UTC+10, no daylight saving; 18 hrs ahead of LA, 15 hrs ahead of Florida).
blocks.notes:
• Not booked — planning assumption: 40,000 Atmos + $123 per person → 160,000 pts + $492 for four.
• Award space for Dec 15, 2027 opens roughly Dec 2026–Jan 2027.

SLEEP PLAN (Brisbane time in brackets):
• Skip the dinner service; seats to bed mode as soon as the seatbelt sign goes off (~10:15 PM LA / 4:15 PM BNE).
• Lights out by ~10:30 PM LA (4:30 PM BNE). Eye masks, earplugs, kids' headphones.
• Let the kids sleep until breakfast — ask the crew to wake them ~90 min before landing (~4:15 AM BNE).
• Adults: aim for 6–8 hrs, up by ~3:00 AM BNE at the latest.
• Breakfast on board; no more sleep after it. Window shades up and screens on so everyone is awake for landing.
blocks.flag:
Apply for each traveller's Australian ETA (official 'Australian ETA' app) before departure — not issued on arrival.
Confirm the exact flight number, times and aircraft when Dec 15, 2027 award space opens.

days.title: Arrive Brisbane — Kangaroo Point Cliffs, river cruise, Riverbar dinner

blocks.title: Arrive BNE — immigration, bags, biosecurity
blocks.detail:
SmartGate for adult US e-passports; kids use the staffed lane with a parent.
Declare any food. Don't carry fruit or snacks off the plane.
75 min gate-to-curb for a family with checked bags — includes a bathroom stop before the rental desk.

blocks.title: Rental car pickup — BNE International terminal rental desks
blocks.detail:
Mid-size SUV from a major brand (Hertz / Avis / Budget / Europcar / Sixt — all have desks in the International terminal arrivals hall; the cars are in the adjacent rental carpark).
One booster seat for the 6-year-old (Queensland law: under 7 must be in an approved restraint). The 8-year-old may legally use the adult belt.
60 min allowed: queue, paperwork, fitting the booster, loading bags, finding the exit. Nothing else depends on this being fast.
blocks.notes:
ONE CAR FOR THE WHOLE TRIP:
• Fri Dec 17 7:05 AM → Thu Dec 23 ~9:45 AM = 7 rental days (6 days + ~2h40m).
• ~AUD 120/day × 7 = AUD 840 + booster ~AUD 50 + tolls ~AUD 20 ≈ AUD 910 ≈ USD 592.
• Mid-December is the priciest month at BNE — re-quote ~6 months out; book on a free-cancellation rate for availability, not price.

WHAT IT DOES:
• Airport → Hyatt today (valet is free on a Globalist award stay).
• Hyatt → Australia Zoo → Noosa on Sat Dec 18, all Noosa errands, Noosa → BNE Domestic on Thu Dec 23.
• NOT the beach — every major brand's terms keep cars on sealed roads and void the insurance on sand. The one beach day is a separate 4WD delivered to the hotel (see Dec 21–22).

blocks.title: Drive BNE → Hyatt Regency Brisbane
blocks.detail:
Airport Drive → Airport Link tunnel (toll, ~AUD 6) → Inner City Bypass → Queen St / Burnett Lane. ~17 km: 25 min in free-flowing traffic; 40 min allowed for the Friday morning peak (school holidays usually thin it).
Drive on the left. Jet-lagged — the passenger navigates, the driver only drives.
Valet at the hotel entrance takes the car; it stays with the valet until Saturday morning.
blocks.notes: • Toll billed to the rental's toll account.

blocks.title: Hyatt Regency Brisbane — valet takes the car, bell desk takes the bags
blocks.detail:
• 33 Burnett Lane (Queen St Mall), middle of the CBD. Category 3 World of Hyatt.
• Room is booked from Thu Dec 16, so it's ready on arrival — bags go straight up.
• Ask for the Deluxe Room, Multiple Beds (sleeps 4) or connecting rooms.
blocks.roomType: Standard room (or standard suite if available)
blocks.notes:
• Modeled at 12,000 pts/night × 2 = 24,000 (the Dec 16 night guarantees the room on arrival).
• Globalist early check-in is only subject to availability — the extra night is the only guarantee.
• Globalist: free valet on an award stay; breakfast for 2 adults + 2 kids.
blocks.flag: Email the hotel: arriving ~8:45 AM Dec 17 — keep the Dec 16 night held (don't treat as no-show).

blocks.title: Breakfast — Lennons (in the hotel)
blocks.detail:
• Straight down after the valet — breakfast before showers.
• Weekday breakfast 6:30–10:00 AM: seated by 9:00.
• Last meal until dinner — no lunch stop today.
blocks.notes: • Globalist benefit: breakfast for 2 adults + 2 kids included. AUD 0.

blocks.title: Back up to the room
blocks.detail: • Buffer: elevator, unpack the essentials.

blocks.title: Showers and change
blocks.detail: • 45 min for four people after a ~30-hour door-to-door journey.

blocks.title: Sunscreen, hats, day bag
blocks.detail:
• UV is Extreme by midday.
• Day bag: water bottles and snacks — no lunch stop until dinner at 5.

blocks.title: Walk to the City Botanic Gardens
blocks.detail: • ~800 m via Albert St to the Alice St gate.

blocks.title: City Botanic Gardens — riverside paths + playground
blocks.detail:
• A full hour here: shaded paths under giant figs, mangrove boardwalk, playground.
• Morning daylight helps reset body clocks — stay outside, no naps today.
• The Kangaroo Point Green Bridge starts at the Alice/Edward St corner of the gardens.

blocks.title: Cross the Kangaroo Point Green Bridge
blocks.detail:
• 470 m walking/cycling bridge over the river (opened Dec 2024).
• Story Bridge and Kangaroo Point Cliffs ahead.

blocks.title: Kangaroo Point Cliffs lookout
blocks.detail:
• The best free view of the city skyline and the river bend.
• Little shade at the top — keep it short.

blocks.title: Riverwalk to South Bank
blocks.detail:
• ~1.5–2 km, flat, along the riverfront past the Maritime Museum.
• 40 min at kid pace, including a water stop.

blocks.title: Wheel of Brisbane
blocks.detail:
• Enclosed, air-conditioned gondolas; ~15-min ride, 60 m up over South Bank.
• 40 min allowed for the queue.
blocks.notes:
ESTIMATE (third-party listing, not the operator's own page):
• ~AUD 20 adult × 2 + ~AUD 14 child × 2 = AUD 68 ≈ USD 44.
• Confirm current price and hours.

blocks.title: Walk to the Cultural Centre pontoon and board
blocks.detail:
• Public pontoon in front of the Queensland Museum / art gallery, South Bank boardwalk.
• Bathroom stop before boarding.

blocks.title: River City Cruises — Mid-Afternoon Sightseeing Cruise (anchor)
blocks.detail:
• 90 min, seated and covered, with commentary; licensed bar on board.
• Downriver past Kangaroo Point Cliffs, under the Story Bridge, out to New Farm and the Powerhouse.
blocks.notes:
VERIFIED (Visit Brisbane listing):
• Family (2 adults + 2 children 5–14) AUD 120 ≈ USD 78.
• Adult AUD 49, child AUD 22.
• Departs the Cultural Centre Public Pontoon, South Bank.
blocks.flag: Confirm the 2:30 PM departure runs on Fridays in December, then book.

blocks.title: CityCat South Bank → Riverside
blocks.detail:
• ~600 m walk along the boardwalk to the South Bank CityCat terminal.
• Flat 50-cent fare per person (tap on with a card or phone).
• Short ride upriver past the CBD; 40 min absorbs one missed boat.

blocks.title: Riverfront boardwalk toward the Story Bridge
blocks.detail: • Eagle St riverwalk, right outside the restaurant.

blocks.title: Dinner — Riverbar & Kitchen, Eagle St
blocks.detail:
• Casual, on the river at Riparian Plaza (71 Eagle St), Story Bridge in view.
• Fish & chips, burgers, pizza, pasta; real kids' menu (12 and under).
• Kitchen open 11:30 AM–9:30 PM on Fridays — book a deck table for 5:00.
blocks.notes:
PRICED FROM THE CURRENT MENU (Oct 2026):
• Beer-battered fish & chips AUD 35
• Riverbar cheeseburger with chips AUD 30
• 2 kids' meals (fish & chips / cheeseburger / ham & pineapple pizza / fettuccine) AUD 15 each
• = AUD 95 ≈ USD 62.

blocks.title: Walk back to the hotel
blocks.detail: • ~700 m up Creek St / Queen St.

blocks.title: Baths, pajamas — lights out by 7:15 PM
blocks.detail:
• Tomorrow's breakfast is 8:00 AM → back-at-hotel deadline 8:00 PM.
• Bags are already packed — nothing to repack tomorrow.

days.title: Brisbane → Australia Zoo → Noosa — Hastings Street, sunset dinner on Main Beach

blocks.title: Breakfast — Lennons (in the hotel)
blocks.detail:
• Weekend breakfast 7:00–11:00 AM.
• At 8:30, ask the valet for the car and the bell desk for the bags.
blocks.notes: • Globalist benefit: breakfast for 2 adults + 2 kids included. AUD 0.

blocks.title: Check out — car out front, bags loaded, booster in
Drive Hyatt → Australia Zoo, Beerwah
blocks.detail:
• Inner City Bypass → Gateway Motorway north (toll) → Bruce Highway (M1) → Steve Irwin Way exit (Glass House Mountains Tourist Route).
• ~80 km, ~1 hr with clear roads; 1h15 allowed for Saturday traffic in Queensland school holidays.
• Bathroom stop at the highway service centre if needed.
blocks.notes: • Toll ~AUD 6 ≈ USD 3.90, billed to the rental's toll account.

blocks.title: Park and walk to the zoo gate
blocks.detail:
• Free on-site parking.
• In school holidays the car park to the gate can take 15–20 min.

blocks.title: Enter Australia Zoo — buy kangaroo food
blocks.detail:
• Family pass bought online beforehand (skips the ticket queue).
• Two bags of roo food at Guest Services or any gift shop.
• Zoo open 9 AM–5 PM daily. A Saturday in school holidays — expect crowds.
blocks.notes:
VERIFIED (prices checked Oct 9, 2026):
• Family of 4 pass (2 adults + 2 children 3–14) AUD 233.95 ≈ USD 152.07.
• Roo food AUD 3 × 2 = AUD 6 ≈ USD 3.90.
• = USD 155.97.

blocks.title: Tigers LIVE! — Tiger Temple, 11:00 AM
blocks.detail:
• Sumatran tigers with their keepers.
• Limited seating — be there by 10:45.

blocks.title: Hand-feed the kangaroos (anchor)
blocks.detail:
• Large walk-through enclosure: pat and hand-feed red and grey kangaroos and several kinds of wallaby.
• Feeding runs all day.

blocks.title: Lunch — Crikey! Café
blocks.detail:
• Burgers, pizza, hot chips, sandwiches, salads — a quick 30 min.
• Watch for birds at the outdoor tables.
blocks.notes:
ESTIMATE — menu prices not published online:
• 2 adult mains ~AUD 20 each
• 2 kids' meals ~AUD 13 each
• = AUD ~66 ≈ USD 43.

blocks.title: Drive Australia Zoo → IGA, Noosa Junction Plaza
blocks.detail:
• Bruce Highway north → Eumundi–Noosa Rd → Noosa Junction.
• ~69 km, ~53 min.

blocks.title: Groceries — IGA, Noosa Junction Plaza
blocks.detail:
• Sunshine Beach Rd, Noosa Heads. Open 6 AM–8 PM daily.
• Breakfast supplies for five mornings, snacks, and 6+ L of water for the beach day.
• There are no shops between the ferry and Rainbow Beach.
blocks.notes:
ESTIMATE:
• ~AUD 180 ≈ USD 117 for five breakfasts, a beach-day picnic, snacks and water.

blocks.title: Drive to Ocean Breeze Resort, Hastings St
blocks.detail: • ~1.5 km down Noosa Drive to Hastings St.

blocks.title: Check in — Ocean Breeze Resort (5 nights); unload, showers, change
blocks.detail:
• 52 Hastings St, Noosa Heads: Main Beach ~3 min and Hastings St ~2 min on foot.
• Two-bedroom apartment: 2 bathrooms, full kitchen, in-unit washer and dryer.
• Check-in from 3:00 PM (front desk 8:30 AM–6:00 PM) — request early access for a 2:45 arrival.
• Parking: one space per unit, first come first served, height limit.
• Parking, check-in, unloading, showers and change; out the door at 4:30.
blocks.notes:
PLACEHOLDER:
• USD 1,236 for 5 nights — a price seen online; dates and room type not yet confirmed.
• Dec 2027 rates are not published yet.
• Guest reviews: dated decor in some units, street and taxi-rank noise in street-facing units, no lifts.
• Check-out by 10:00 AM.
blocks.flag: Confirm the price is a two-bedroom for Dec 18–23, 2027; request a unit away from Hastings St; confirm the SUV clears the garage height and where the 4WD parks Dec 21–22.

blocks.title: Hastings Street and the Main Beach boardwalk
blocks.detail: • The shops and cafés of Hastings St, then the boardwalk along Main Beach — finishing at the surf club.

blocks.title: Dinner — Noosa Heads Surf Club
blocks.detail:
Upstairs at the surf lifesaving club, 69 Hastings St, right on Main Beach — ~300 m from Ocean Breeze.
Fish & chips, steaks, pasta, salads, seafood; kids' menu all day.
Deck over Laguna Bay: sunset 6:38 PM lights up the bay and the North Shore (the sun sets behind the hills to the west-southwest).
Walk-ins only — be there by 5:45 on a Saturday in the holidays to beat the queue.
blocks.notes:
PRICED FROM A MENU LISTING (Aug 2025; the club's own menu is an image):
• Fish & chips AUD 24–28 → 26
• Chicken parmigiana AUD 28–32 → 30
• 2 × kids (nuggets / mini fish & chips / pasta) AUD 12–14 → 13
• = AUD ~82 ≈ USD 53.

blocks.title: Bed
blocks.detail: • Tomorrow's breakfast is 8:00 AM → back-at-hotel deadline 8:00 PM.

days.title: Noosa — Main Beach, then sand flats and sunset on the Spit

blocks.title: Sunscreen, hats, walk to Main Beach
blocks.detail: • ~3 min from Ocean Breeze.

blocks.title: Main Beach, Noosa (anchor)
blocks.detail:
Noosa Main Beach faces north into Laguna Bay — sheltered from the swell, the calmest patrolled beach on this coast, the one for young kids.
Between the flags in front of the surf club.

blocks.title: Lunch — Betty's Burgers, Hastings Street (the original)
blocks.detail:
Betty's started here before it went national. Order-at-counter burgers, fries, shakes.
Hastings St, a few minutes from Main Beach.
blocks.notes:
PRICED FROM THE MENU (Sep 2026):
• 2 × Betty's Classic AUD 11.90
• 2 × Kids beef burger AUD 8.90
• = AUD 41.60 ≈ USD 27. Fries excluded.

blocks.title: Apartment — showers, rest
blocks.detail: • Out of the midday sun before the evening at the Spit.

blocks.title: Drive to the Noosa Woods / Spit car park
blocks.detail:
• ~1.5 km to the river end of Hastings St, ~5 min.
• The car park fills on summer weekends — fallback: park at Ocean Breeze and walk ~15 min.

blocks.title: Noosa Spit — sand flats and sunset (anchor)
blocks.detail:
• Where the Noosa River meets Laguna Bay: calm, warm, shallow water over sandbars, tiny fish, soldier crabs, no surf.
• The tide falls all afternoon to a 7:09 PM low (0.51 m, BOM 2027 prediction, Noosa Head) — the flats keep growing until dark.
• Sunset 6:38 PM over the river and the hinterland hills; light to walk until ~7:05.
• Stay on the river side of the spit; the ocean side is unpatrolled.

blocks.title: Drive back to Ocean Breeze, park
Walk to Zachary's
blocks.detail: • 15 Hastings St, ~400 m.

blocks.title: Dinner — Zachary's Gourmet Pizza Bar, Hastings St
blocks.detail:
• Relaxed wood-fired pizza and pasta bar; walk in straight from the beach — beach clothes are fine.
• Open 7 days, noon until late.
blocks.notes:
ESTIMATE — menu prices not published online:
• 2 adult mains (large pizza / pasta) ~AUD 28 each
• 2 kids' meals ~AUD 16 each
• = AUD ~88 ≈ USD 57. (A 2022 review put most large pizzas under AUD 25.)

blocks.title: Bed
blocks.detail: • Tomorrow starts later: breakfast 8:15, out the door at 9:00.

days.title: Noosa National Park — Granite Bay and Tea Tree Bay; Noosaville riverfront

blocks.title: Breakfast in the apartment; pack the picnic
blocks.detail: • Picnic lunch from the IGA shop, 2 L+ of water each, hats, sunscreen, reef shoes for the rock pools.

blocks.title: Boardwalk to the Noosa National Park day-use area
blocks.detail: • ~1 km of seaside boardwalk from Hastings St, with some steps.

blocks.title: Boiling Pot lookout
blocks.detail: • 300 m in on the sealed track.

blocks.title: Coastal track past Tea Tree Bay and Dolphin Point to Granite Bay
blocks.detail:
• Tea Tree Bay 750 m, Dolphin Point 1.3 km, Granite Bay 1.7 km from the day-use area.
• Sealed to Dolphin Point; unsealed with some steps after.
• Koalas are regularly spotted in the trees along this stretch.

blocks.title: Granite Bay — boulders and rock pools
blocks.detail:
• Big black granite boulders, rock pools, a pebbly-sandy beach.
• Go early: the beach disappears at high tide (1:20 PM today, BOM 2027 prediction).
• Steep track down. Unpatrolled — no swimming.

blocks.title: Walk back to Tea Tree Bay
Tea Tree Bay — beach play, rock pools, picnic lunch (anchor)
blocks.detail:
• The prettiest bay in the park: sand, rock pools with crabs and small fish.
• Picnic lunch around 12:15. Toilets and tap water here.
• Unpatrolled — paddling at the edge only; Parks Queensland advises against swimming.
• Keep food covered: brush turkeys and lace monitors.

blocks.title: Walk out and the boardwalk back to Hastings St
blocks.detail: • 750 m to the day-use area, then ~1 km of boardwalk.

blocks.title: Drive to Noosaville
blocks.detail:
• ~6 km along Noosa Parade / Gympie Terrace.
• Park at the Yacht & Rowing Club precinct or Quota Park.

blocks.title: Noosaville riverfront walk
blocks.detail:
• Flat 2 km strip of riverside paths and parks along Gympie Terrace: Chaplin Park, Lions Park with the Pirate Playground, Quota Park and the Big Pelican, Pelican Beach Park.
• Small river beaches, boats coming and going, cafés along the path. Toilets and showers in several parks.

blocks.title: Dinner — Noosa Yacht & Rowing Club
blocks.detail:
• The club's Riverside Bistro at Lions Park, on the water next to the Pirate Playground.
• 5:30 PM sitting (vacate by 6:50) — bookings strongly advised.
• No kids' menu; half serves for little ones.
blocks.notes:
PRICED FROM THE CLUB'S SUMMER 2023–24 MENU (expect higher by 2027):
• Fish & chips AUD 28.90
• Crispy-skin barramundi AUD 21.90
• 2 kids' half-serve fish & chips AUD 16.50 each
• = AUD 83.80 ≈ USD 54.

days.title: Noosa Spit sand flats — 4WD delivered tonight

blocks.title: Walk to Noosa Spit
blocks.detail: • West along Hastings St to Noosa Woods and the Spit, ~1 km.

blocks.title: Noosa Spit — the river-mouth sand flats (anchor)
blocks.detail:
Where the Noosa River meets Laguna Bay: calm, warm, ankle-to-waist-deep water over sandbars, tiny fish, soldier crabs, no surf.
Low tide is 8:24 AM (BOM 2027 prediction, Noosa Head) — the flats are at their widest from ~7 to 10:30, then slowly fill toward the 2:21 PM high.
Shade under the casuarinas on the river side. Stay on the river side of the spit; the ocean side is unpatrolled.

blocks.title: Lunch — Betty's Burgers, Hastings Street (the original)
blocks.detail:
Betty's started here before it went national. Order-at-counter burgers, fries, shakes.
Hastings St, next to Ocean Breeze.
blocks.notes:
PRICED FROM THE MENU (Sep 2026):
• 2 × Betty's Classic AUD 11.90
• 2 × Kids beef burger AUD 8.90
• = AUD 41.60 ≈ USD 27. Fries excluded.

blocks.title: Hastings Street — gelato, surf-shop souvenirs, Lions Park playground
blocks.detail: • The village end of the trip. Lions Park playground is just off Hastings St.
blocks.notes: • ~AUD 90 for gelato and a couple of small souvenirs ≈ USD 60 (not a meal — not part of the dining audit).

blocks.title: Quiet afternoon in the apartment — 5:15 AM start tomorrow
blocks.detail: • Out of the midday sun; naps for anyone who needs one.

blocks.title: Buy the Cooloola permit; check tomorrow's conditions
blocks.detail:
Cooloola vehicle access permit for Dec 22 online (AUD 15.40 for the calendar day, plate-recognised, nothing to display) — you'll need the 4WD's plate number from the operator.
Check the QPWS Cooloola conditions report and the ferry's timetable/tide page.
Pack the beach bags: 6 L water, picnic breakfast and lunch, sunscreen, hats, rash shirts, towels, dry bag, sand shoes.

blocks.title: 4WD delivered to Ocean Breeze — handover and beach briefing
blocks.detail:
Noosa 2 Fraser / Noosa2K'gari 4WD Hire (Richard, Pomona/Doonan yard) delivers a Prado/Pajero-class 4WD to Ocean Breeze (52 Hastings St) for a one-day hire: tonight's handover, tomorrow's drive, collected here tomorrow evening or Thursday morning.
30-min briefing: tyre pressures (they supply gauge, compressor and recovery kit), the tide chart, where the Third Cutting is, 80 km/h beach / 40 km/h camping-zone limits, Mudlo Rocks, no night driving.
Move the booster seat across from the rental. Load the beach bags tonight.
blocks.flag: Book by email (info@noosa2fraser.com.au) and get the delivery to Ocean Breeze, the evening handover, the evening-of-Dec-22 collection and the one-day price confirmed in writing — their default meeting point is the Tewantin ferry carpark. Ocean Breeze allows one parking space per unit: confirm where the 4WD parks overnight.
blocks.notes:
COST:
• Day hire AUD 225 (BookMe listing; confirm direct)
• Excess reduction AUD 29 (AUD 5,000 excess → AUD 1,800)
• Cooloola permit AUD 15.40 (on the logistics block)
• Ferry one way AUD 15
• = AUD ~284 ≈ USD 185 — plus fuel on the drive block.

WHY THIS OPERATOR:
• Reviewers report exactly this shape of hire: 'picked up the 4WD the night before, drove to Rainbow Beach and back along 40 km of beach'; 'offered to hand over the car the very same evening so we could head up the beach early'; a car left at the airport on request.
• Pomona/Doonan is ~20 min from Hastings St, so delivery is a short hop for him.

BACKUPS:
• Drop Bear Adventures, 3 Sanders St, Noosaville (10 min away) — LandCruisers with permit and recovery gear included, but they push multi-day hires.
• East Coast 4WD Hire (Prado, AUD 395/day).
• Guided: Great Beach Drive 4WD Tours, 8-hr day with lunch, ferry and permits, max 6 guests — the no-driving fallback.

DRIVER: 30–75 years old, 3+ years on a full licence; a US licence is fine — carry it.

blocks.title: Dinner in the apartment
blocks.detail: Kitchen night — something easy from Saturday's shop. Early and quiet on purpose.

blocks.title: Bed — lights out 7:30 PM
blocks.detail: Tomorrow's ready time is 5:45 AM → deadline 5:45 PM. This runs ~1 hr over for the one early start of the week; 9.5 hrs of sleep and a slow Thursday after it.

days.title: 4WD day — Teewah Beach, the Double Island Point lagoon, Rainbow Beach

blocks.title: Up, quick breakfast, into the 4WD
blocks.detail: Light by 4:50. Cereal and fruit in the apartment; picnic and water already in the car. 35 min because it's two kids at 5 AM.

blocks.title: Drive to the Noosa North Shore Ferry, Tewantin
blocks.detail: Hastings St → Noosa Parade → Gympie Terrace → Moorindil St. ~10 km, 20 min, plus 5 for the queue lane.

blocks.title: Car ferry across the Noosa River
blocks.detail:
Cable ferry, every ~10 min, from 5:30 AM. The crossing is 5 min; the pre-Christmas queue can be 15–25 min — that's what the 25-min block is.
Pay on board by card, or a QR ticket bought online.
blocks.notes: • AUD 15 one way per car. One crossing today — the return is inland.

blocks.title: Onto the beach — the Third Cutting
blocks.detail:
Off the ferry: 2.2 km Maximillian Rd → right onto Beach Rd, 2.1 km of bitumen → the marked third sand cutting (the only legal entry).
At the top of the cutting: tyres down to ~18 psi, 4WD engaged. Bathroom stop for the kids at the Noosa North Shore campground on the way past.
First 3 km past the camping area is 40 km/h.

blocks.title: Teewah Beach north — 40 km on the sand
blocks.detail:
The beach is the road: firm sand below the high-water line, 80 km/h limit, 40 km/h past the camping zones, pedestrians and anglers own the beach.
Teewah village and the coloured cliffs slide past on the left.
One 15-min stop at the Red Canyon (red-sand gully in the cliffs, ~35 km up) — the kids can run up it.
blocks.notes:
TIDE — official Bureau of Meteorology 2027 predictions, Noosa Head standard port (AEST, LAT datum):
• Wed Dec 22: high 3:45 AM 1.65 m → LOW 9:43 AM 0.82 m → high 3:24 PM 1.55 m → low 9:54 PM.
• Range 0.73 m — a neap (new moon Dec 27). Beach drivable roughly 7:15 AM–12:15 PM (low ±2½ hrs); QPWS rule is never within 2 hrs of high water.
• The other candidates: Tue Dec 21 low 8:24 AM (0.77 m); Thu Dec 23 low 10:58 AM (0.82 m). Dec 22 is the latest start that still clears Rainbow Beach before noon.
• Double Island Point sits ~55 km north of the Noosa Head gauge on the same open coast — same tide within minutes.
• Source: BOM tide predictions 2027 via ausmarinescience.com (Noosa Head; Mooloolaba cross-checked: low 9:43 AM both).

blocks.title: Leisha Track — over the headland to the lagoon
blocks.detail:
At the base of Double Island Point the beach ends. The Leisha Track is a short sand track across the back of the headland to the north (Rainbow Beach) side.
The lagoon is 400 m from the track's northern end.

blocks.title: Double Island Point lagoon — 2 hours (anchor)
blocks.detail:
The turquoise lagoon behind the sand spit on the north side of the point.
Sheltered from the wind and the swell; calm, clear, shallow. Fish, soldier crabs in their thousands at low tide, turtles and dolphins in the channel.
Low tide is 9:43 AM (BOM 2027 prediction), right in the middle of this block — the lagoon at its shallowest and warmest, refilling as the tide turns.
Wading, swimming, picnic on the spit. Unpatrolled — an adult in the water with the kids, and stay in the shallows, not the channel mouth.
Honeymoon Bay (the calm cove on the point itself) is 5 min back if the lagoon is busy.
blocks.notes:
• No facilities at the point — toilets are at the Freshwater day-use area 5 km south (a 10-min detour on the way up if needed).
• The lighthouse walk (800 m from the north side, steep) is a skip — the lagoon is the point.

blocks.title: Dry off, change, back in the car
blocks.detail: 20 min. Sandy kids, wet swimmers, sunscreen again.

blocks.title: North up Rainbow Beach to the township
blocks.detail:
~10 km on the sand past the Coloured Sands cliffs.
Mudlo Rocks sit at the town end — passable near low tide only. At 11:00 you're ~1h15 after the 9:43 low on a neap; fine, but don't dawdle.
If the rocks are covered: turn back to the Leisha Track, take the Freshwater Track inland to Rainbow Beach Rd (+45 min).

blocks.title: Off the beach at the Rainbow Beach ramp — tyres up
blocks.detail: Council carpark, end of Rainbow Beach Rd. Compressor back to road pressure, 15 min.

blocks.title: Drive up to the Carlo Sand Blow carpark
blocks.detail: 5 min up Cooloola Drive.

blocks.title: Carlo Sand Blow (dunes)
blocks.detail:
600 m walk up through the forest (steep, steps) onto a 15-hectare bare sand blow on top of the headland.
360° views: Rainbow Beach, Inskip Point, Tin Can Bay, K'gari on the horizon.
This is the dunes piece of Fraser — run, roll, slide down the leeward face. Shoes on, the sand is hot by now; 20 min up, 25 on top, 15 down.

The freshwater rinse after a salty morning. Picnic tables, toilets, free.

items.name: Hyatt Regency Brisbane
items.note: Dec 16–18 on points (2 × 12,000 = 24,000 modeled). The Dec 16 night guarantees the room at 9:15 AM on Dec 17 — tell the hotel you arrive that morning so it isn't a no-show.

items.name: Australian ETA
items.note: One per traveller via the official app before departure.

items.name: Child Opal cards
items.note: Buy 2 in Sydney (kids can't tap a credit card).

items.name: Meals
items.note: 2 adult mains + 2 kids' meals, no drinks/starters/dessert. Each meal labeled verified (current menu) or estimate.

items.name: Exchange rate
items.note: AUD × 0.65 = USD.

items.name: Hamilton Island surcharges
items.note: Restaurants add 10% Sundays and 15% public holidays (Dec 25, 27, 28 in 2027).

items.name: Pullman Brisbane Airport night
items.note: Dropped — flying BNE → HTI the morning after Noosa.

items.name: NYE restaurant packages
items.note: Kid-friendly harbour terraces exist (e.g., Luna Lu ~AUD 3,670 for 4) but too expensive.

items.name: Watsons Bay + Doyles
items.note: Cut when Sydney went to 4 full days.

items.name: Free foreshore spots (Mrs Macquaries etc.)
items.note: Fill by early afternoon — an all-day wait with the kids.
